items.title: File Widerspruch against partial rejection of insole cost coverage
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Widerspruch erhoben werden.
items.computation: Sender is a statutory health insurance fund (Körperschaft des öffentlichen Rechts), so the delivery fiction of § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X applies: a letter sent by post is deemed delivered on the third day after it was handed to the post. Document date (presumed date of posting) = Monday, 14.04.2025. Third day after = Thursday, 17.04.2025 (not a Sunday/holiday, so no shift) -> Bekanntgabe = 17.04.2025. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist then runs under §§ 26 SGB X, 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe is not counted, the period starts 18.04.2025 and ends one month later on the day bearing the same number, i.e. 17.05.2025. That day is a Saturday; under § 193 BGB the deadline moves to the next business day, Monday 19.05.2025 (no NRW public holiday intervenes). Final deadline: 19.05.2025.

warnings: The exact delivery date relies on the statutory 3-day postal fiction (§ 37 Abs. 2 SGB X) starting from the letter's printed date, since no separate postmark or dispatch date is given; if the letter was actually posted later, the deadline shifts accordingly.
